sloka: पर्णशाला तथा चित्रा दृश्यते शुभदर्शना ।यत्र त्वं राक्षसेन्द्रेण रावणेन हृता बलात् ।। ६.१२६.४० ।।
transliteration: parṇaśālā tathā citrā dṛśyate śubhadarśanā ।yatra tvaṁ rākṣasendreṇa rāvaṇena hṛtā balāt ।। 6.126.40 ।।

translations.english: After Rama and all others ascended and Pushpaka rose up speedily over the Rshyamuka, gazing at Rshyamuka, Rama spoke toVaidehi.
